record.question: After a week-long strike, the workers took to the path of collision when the chairman intervened.
record.explanation: Answer C: reconciliation. The printed word underlined in Q48 is 'collision'. The shared direction asks for its closest opposite. 'Reconciliation' means restoring agreement and is the only offered contrast to collision; retaliation, atonement and expiation do not mean reconciliation. Independently reviewed best-choice solution, unofficial; no examiner key is asserted.
